title: attendance.settings.update
description: Time clock settings (one row per hub). The screen sends the full snapshot. A flag is `integer` + `enum: [0, 1]` on purpose (staff#24): the shell's generic form paints it as a toggle.

require_location.title: Require location when clocking in from a personal device
require_location.description: The counter POS (shared device) is never asked for a location.

geofence_radius_m.title: Allowed radius (metres)
geofence_radius_m.description: How far from the workplace a personal device may clock in.

workplace_lat.title: Workplace latitude
workplace_lat.description: Leave empty until the workplace location is set.

workplace_lng.title: Workplace longitude
workplace_lng.description: Leave empty until the workplace location is set.

auto_close_after_hours.title: Flag open days for review after (hours)
auto_close_after_hours.description: A working day still open after this many hours is marked for review.
